meta.status: Imported into breed_stage_params by M5-R06-03 (2026-10-08, BreedStageParamsSeeder::catRows(), data_ref = "cat-data:" + JSON path; CatLifeStageDataTest checks every row against this file). Written after David approved CAT_SPEC Q1–Q10 (2026-10-08 13:47).

conventions.value_object: {value, unit, source_id, quote, confidence, notes[, decision]}
conventions.confidence: Same scale as dog-data: high = guideline / standard / peer-reviewed and consistent; medium = single reputable source or small disagreement; low = secondary source, strong disagreement, or derived/proposal
conventions.unsourced: source_id null and no decision → 'UNSOURCED — proposal (D)'; must not be shown to parents/children as fact.
conventions.decision: "potrdil David 2026-10-08 13:47: …" = a game value David confirmed (CAT_SPEC §0 Q1–Q10). It is a product decision, NOT literature; source_id stays the underlying evidence (null where the literature gives no number).
conventions.quotes: As returned by the web-fetch tool on 2026-10-08 (see sources.md). Spot-check C1, C14, C16, C17 against the URL before import.
conventions.game_time: 1 real week = 1 month of cat age (CAT_SPEC §2, same as dogs).
conventions.stage_mapping: Existing LifeStage values are reused: puppy = kitten, young = young adult, adult = mature adult, senior = senior (CAT_SPEC §2).
conventions.breed_keys: BreedType value (domestic_cat, maine_coon, british_shorthair, ragdoll, siberian_cat, norwegian_forest_cat, bengal) vs breed_configs slug (domestic-cat, maine-coon, british-shorthair, ragdoll, siberian-cat, norwegian-forest-cat, bengal), same split as border_collie / border-collie.

marketing.notes: Not a flat-faced breed (FIFe C43: full, broad muzzle; nose line slightly concave to nearly straight). The Bengal descends from a wild-cat hybrid: the FelineVMA (C48) opposes breeding wild cats to domestic cats and discourages owning early-generation (F1–F3) hybrids, and The Cat Group (incl. BSAVA, C50) does not support breeding or keeping wild cat hybrids — but no veterinary association advises against showing registered domestic Bengals in advertising (runbook §3), so the breed stays in marketing. Marketing shows only the registered domestic Bengal (never a wild cat or an early-generation hybrid), never promises an easy cat for small children (C45), never "hypoallergenic". Open for David (HANDOFF). Cats are hidden in the app — no cat marketing before the switch-on (M5-R06-09).
marketing.decision: potrdil David 2026-10-10 (pravilo runbooka, M5-R10-18): may be used in marketing once cats are switched on (no veterinary advice against advertising the breed; hybrid position statements C48 / C50 open for David)
